design: Frozen six H755 scalar dictionaries. Learn128 groups of4 shared atoms with own anchor, fixed512 memberships. Two selected groups decode exact union (<=8 unique atoms), never double count. Initializations: stable-half Top8-support correlation and random anchored groups. Ten discrete membership-update rounds maximizing training raw squared coefficient energy; assignment greedy plus4 alternating bestresponses; retain best training score including initial. Evaluate both initial/learned models and three degree-preserving rewires per learned fit. Same validation gate. Scalar8 and per-example union-size-matched scalar controls. No task data in fitting.
limitations: Proxy energy objective, nonorthogonal decoder, frozen dictionary and coefficients, local optimization with anchors. Not jointly trained shared-gate architecture. Fixed group/membership counts substitute for membership penalty. Randomized memberships preserve row/column degrees but need not retain anchors. Nominal8slots, actual unique count recorded. Validation evaluated only; reused split and no original reserved-test evaluation.
